description: Tenant deal store (libs/core/organization/deal-store.ts asDealStore, S3): every read and write of a tenant's customer records — deals, deal documents, requirements captures, escalations and the deal log under knowledge/confidential/<tenant>/deals/ — runs as this role, bound to that tenant (tenant-bound: libs/core/authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES), and scripts/customer_decision.ts respond / confirm uses it for the best-effort deal note (CD-08), so neither the customer-triggered path nor a surface needs mission_controller or a confidential-tier grant. Only the deal file IO runs under it; callers keep their own role for notifications and the memory promotion queue. No other knowledge, decision ledger, agenda, receipt or invite authority.
